MODULE_NOTES: Every tooltip in the Ordaen style: items, abilities, effects, players, NPCs and objects.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSON_TIP: Off: item tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_SPELLSON_TIP: Off: ability tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_AURASON_TIP: Off: buff and debuff tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_OBJECTSON_TIP: Off: tooltips of signs, chests and gathering nodes stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_PLAYERSON_TIP: Off: player tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_NPCSON_TIP: Off: NPC and creature tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSILVL_TIP: The first row of the stats.
TOOLTIPS_ANCHORTOBUTTONS_TIP: A button's tooltip shows above the button (action bars, the micro menu) instead of in the corner. Only where it shows, never what it says.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSANCHORBAGS_TIP: For items in the bags and the bank. In the corner: bottom right. Beside the item: at its slot.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSANCHORCHAR_TIP: For equipped items in the character window. In the corner: bottom right. Beside the item: at its slot.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSCOUNT_TIP: In the bags and in the bank.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSCOOLDOWN_TIP: How long until it can be used again.
TOOLTIPS_SPELLSCOOLDOWN_TIP: How long until it can be cast again.
TOOLTIPS_AURASCASTER_TIP: The name in its class colour; «You» for yours.
TOOLTIPS_PLAYERSRELATION_TIP: Your group or raid, your friends, your ignore list.
TOOLTIPS_NPCSLOOT_TIP: The name grey when the loot isn't yours.
